title: Collection of Guest Payments on a Stay — Payments Operations Standard
content:
# Collection of guest payments

This standard governs how money is collected from the guest on a reservation in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category.

## Plans

- **Recorded at booking.** Every stay records its payment plan at booking.
- **Paid in full.** The whole total price is collected as installment 1 when the stay is confirmed.
- **Pay-part-now.** It may be chosen only on a cancellation policy that makes it available, only at the standard rate, and only when the booking date is at least the policy's minimum lead in calendar days before check-in. Installment 1 collects the policy's deposit percentage of every component, each rounded to the cent, at confirmation; installment 2 collects the remainder of every component on the balance due date, the policy's balance-due number of calendar days before the check-in date.
- **Monthly installments.** They apply to every stay of a cancellation policy that uses monthly installments. Installment 1 covers the first block of the policy's nights per installment and is collected at confirmation; installment n covers the next block of that many nights (or the nights that remain, if fewer) and is collected on the first night it covers. The cleaning, pet and extra-guest fees are collected with installment 1.
- *No longer in force:* the former clause that each installment carries the guest service fee and occupancy tax attributable to the amounts it collects is no longer in force as worded; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Where money is collected

*No longer in force:* the former clause "Money is collected only on a confirmed or checked-in stay." is no longer in force as worded; it has been superseded by the current basis.

## Failed collections and lapse

- A failed scheduled collection is recorded as a failed payment and retried up to the policy's number of automatic retries.
- A confirmed stay is cancelled for non-payment only when the installment is still unpaid the policy's failed-payment grace period after the first failed collection attempt for that installment. That elapsed time is counted in full 24-hour clock hours from the posting time of the first failed attempt, and a collection at any moment before the boundary keeps the stay. The moment that decides is taken from the failed-payment entries on the stay's ledger for that same installment.
- A stay cancelled for non-payment takes the status cancelled by guest and is refunded exactly as a guest cancellation dated at the lapse.
- An installment that fails while the stay is already checked in is never cancelled for non-payment under this rule.

## Lapse timeline (hypothetical installment, grace period of 48 elapsed hours)

| Moment | Elapsed since first failed attempt | Installment state | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2026-03-02 10:15:00 — first failed attempt posted | 0 hours | unpaid | stay remains confirmed; retries follow |
| 2026-03-04 10:14:59 — guest's collection succeeds | just under 48 hours | paid | the stay is kept |
| 2026-03-04 10:15:00 — still unpaid | exactly 48 hours | unpaid | the stay is cancelled for non-payment |

## Deposit share (hypothetical)

On a hypothetical pay-part-now stay with a deposit percentage of 50.00%, a cleaning fee of 85.25 contributes 42.63 to installment 1 (42.625 rounded half up to the cent) and the remainder, 42.62, to installment 2; every other component is split the same way, each rounded on its own.

superseded_clauses: Money is collected only on a confirmed or checked-in stay.
each installment carries the guest service fee and occupancy tax attributable to the amounts it collects
